 "data": "erDiagram

 OCB_CUSTOMER {
 string ocb_customer_id PK
 }

 OCB_CUSTOMER_IDENTITY {

 string ocb_customer_id FK
 }

 ANANSE_CUSTOMER {
 string customer_id PK
 string first_name
 string last_name
 date date_of_birth
 string nationality
 string occupation
 string phone_number
 string email
 datetime created_at
 }

 ANANSE_WALLET {
 string wallet_id PK
 }

 ANANSE_TRANSACTION {
 string transaction_id PK
 string customer_id FK
 string wallet_id FK
 string transaction_type
 string transaction_status
 datetime transaction_timestamp
 string transaction_location
 string transaction_channel
 string device_id
 decimal amount
 string currency
 }

 SIKACREDIT_CUSTOMER {
 string customer_id PK
 string first_name
 string last_name
 date date_of_birth
 string nationality
 string occupation
 string phone_number
 string email
 datetime created_at
 }

 SIKACREDIT_LOAN {
 string loan_id PK
 string customer_id FK
 datetime disbursement_timestamp
 string disbursement_location
 date maturity_date
 decimal principal_amount
 decimal interest_rate
 string currency
 }

 SIKACREDIT_REPAYMENT {
 string repayment_id PK
 string loan_id FK
 decimal repayment_amount
 datetime repayment_timestamp
 string repayment_location
 }

 OMAN_REMIT_CUSTOMER {
 string customer_id PK
 string first_name
 string last_name
 date date_of_birth
 string nationality
 string occupation
 string phone_number
 string email
 datetime created_at
 }

 OMAN_REMIT_REMITTANCE {
 string remittance_id PK
 string customer_id FK
 string remittance_status
 datetime remittance_timestamp
 string transaction_location
 decimal amount
 string currency
 string origin_country
 string destination_country
 string transaction_channel
 }
